milestone.name: K7.7.1 - Continuity Re-entry State Extraction
milestone.summary: Freeze extraction of continuation posture, cognitive momentum, and re-entry intention before runtime resume implementation.

review.name: K7.7.1 Continuity Re-entry Extraction Contract Freeze

principle: Extract continuation posture, not previous conversation content.
acceptance_targets: Extractor outputs current cognitive position, not only topic labels.
Extractor outputs Cognitive Momentum with active_problem, current_hypothesis, unresolved_tension, and expected_next_step.
Extractor outputs relationship moment and interaction momentum.
Extractor records lifecycle state and re-entry weight.
Extractor does not store raw transcript.
Extractor does not store recent message copy.
Extractor does not generate wake-up text or final answer templates.
Extractor does not mutate identity, relationship, memory, or experience artifacts.
Extracted state passes Re-entry Quality Score threshold.
